anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.ota_headline: The Dunes Hotel & Resort: Your Vibrant Family Beach Escape in Plettenberg Bay
anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Discover your perfect family holiday at The Dunes Hotel & Resort, nestled in the serene Keurboomstrand, Plettenberg Bay. With direct access to pristine beaches and a vibrant outdoor pool, we offer an unforgettable coastal experience. Our comfortable rooms and lively dining options cater to all ages, ensuring a relaxing and fun-filled stay. Enjoy a welcoming atmosphere, friendly service, and a host of activities designed for families and groups. Explore the natural beauty of the Garden Route, knowing you have a comfortable and engaging retreat to return to. The Dunes is where cherished holiday memories are made.
